SELECT
    pi.uid
FROM programinstance pi
JOIN organisationunit ou
    ON ou.organisationunitid = pi.organisationunitid
WHERE pi.programid = 4170
AND ou.path LIKE '%RRhUcshq3Kz%'
and pi.deleted =  false
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM programstageinstance psi
    WHERE psi.programinstanceid = pi.programinstanceid
      AND psi.programstageid = 4117
)
limit 100;
